svg.aria-label: The sinusoidal pattern as a position-by-dimension grid: low channels oscillate fast, high channels slow.
svg.title: Sinusoidal positional encoding as a position-by-dimension grid
svg.desc: A grid whose vertical axis is position (0 at top, increasing downward) and whose horizontal axis is the embedding dimension (channel 0 at left, increasing rightward). Each column is a sinusoid down the position axis; the leftmost columns oscillate rapidly (high frequency, short wavelength) and the frequency decreases smoothly toward the right (low frequency, long wavelength), showing a geometric progression of wavelengths. Two rows are marked, pos and pos plus k a fixed offset apart, with a note that PE(pos+k) is a linear function of PE(pos), so relative position is a fixed linear shift.
svg.text: for a fixed offset k, PE(pos + k) is a linear function of PE(pos) → attending by relative position is a fixed linear shift
